labels.name: bug
labels.description: Confirmed bug: the reported behaviour is real and the report carried the device details and, where they are required, the logs

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: A well-reasoned proposal for an improvement or new functionality

labels.name: question
labels.description: A genuine question about using or understanding the application, not a bug report

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Filed in good faith, but the claim is not confirmed by the code, is user error, or asks for something the project deliberately does not do

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Not enough to reach a conclusion: missing device details, missing shell version, missing logs for a renderer report, or no reproduction steps

labels.name: needs-logs
labels.description: A rendering, preview, effects, export or performance report with no logs from the moment of the problem. In-app logs do not exist for a crash — LogFox or adb output is required instead

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Looks like an already-existing issue or pull request

labels.name: docs
labels.description: About documentation, not code

labels.name: good-pr
labels.description: A solid pull request: clear diff, states where it was tested, screenshots attached if the interface changed, follows the conventions

labels.name: needs-work
labels.description: A legitimate pull request whose diff has problems: no test result, no screenshots for a UI change, a stale comment deleted, a hardcoded string, or logic in the wrong layer

labels.name: trash
labels.description: Junk: spam, advertising, abuse, no real content, bots

labels.name: spam
labels.description: Flooding: too many issues from the same author in a short time (mechanical antispam, not AI)

labels.name: moderation-removed
labels.description: Content removed automatically: personal data (doxxing) and/or severe targeted abuse (mechanical moderation action, not a quality label)

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Technical fallback label: the model returned a value that is not in this list

labels.name: soc-snapdragon
labels.description: Device detail: Qualcomm Snapdragon. Applied from the report, never guessed when the chip is unclear

labels.name: soc-exynos
labels.description: Device detail: Samsung Exynos

labels.name: soc-tensor
labels.description: Device detail: Google Tensor

labels.name: soc-mtk
labels.description: Device detail: MediaTek, Dimensity or Helio

labels.name: soc-kirin
labels.description: Device detail: HiSilicon Kirin

labels.name: soc-unisoc
labels.description: Device detail: Unisoc

labels.name: soc-unclear
labels.description: Device detail: the report does not say which chip, or it is one this list does not cover. The issue stays needs-info until it does — a renderer report without the chip cannot be reproduced
